text: Joanna is a writer whose laptop crashed last week; she lost all work but now uses an external drive for backups. She prefers dairy-free desserts: chocolate raspberry tart (almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, fresh raspberries) and dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries (almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate). Nate taught vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show last Monday; favorite is coconut milk ice cream; also likes dairy-free chocolate mousse.
